turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, I’m your doctor today. What brings you in today? Patient: I’ve been getting more confused lately, and I can’t quite get the words out the way I used to. I also have had a fever around 102°F and it hurts when you press my right upper abdomen.

When did the confusion, trouble speaking, fever, and right upper abdominal pain start?
When did the confusion, trouble speaking, fever, and right upper abdominal pain start?

Doctor: When did the confusion, trouble speaking, fever, and right upper abdominal pain start? Patient: It started about two days ago with the confusion, and the fever came shortly after—within the same day. The right upper belly pain has been there since the fever began.
Have you noticed any yellowing of your eyes or skin, dark urine, or pale stools?

Doctor: Have you noticed any yellowing of your eyes or skin, dark urine, or pale stools? Patient: I can’t say for sure about my urine color or stool color, but I don’t remember anyone mentioning yellowing of my eyes or skin.
Have you had nausea or vomiting, and do you have shaking chills or rigors?
Patient: I’ve had some nausea but I don’t think I’ve vomited, and I’ve had episodes where I feel very chilled with shaking.
Do you have any history of gallstones, prior gallbladder problems, liver disease, or heavy alcohol use?

I don’t know about gallstones specifically, and I haven’t been told of any gallbladder or liver disease that I remember. I do know I’m in home hospice for a chronic illness, but I can’t recall details, and I don’t know about any heavy alcohol history.
Have you had any low blood pressure, fast heart rate, trouble breathing, or has anyone said you seem unusually sleepy or hard to wake?

Patient: I’ve seemed more unusually sleepy and harder to wake than usual, and my breathing has felt a bit faster when I’m not resting. I don’t know about my blood pressure, but my heart has seemed to race at times, especially when I feel chilled.
Do you have pain or burning with urination, cough, severe headache, neck stiffness, or any new weakness/numbness on one side?
Patient: No burning when I urinate, and I don’t have a cough. I don’t recall a severe headache or neck stiffness, but I have felt weaker overall and more confused.
Have you had any recent procedures or tubes involving the bile ducts or gallbladder, such as an ERCP, biliary stent, drain, or gallbladder surgery?

I don’t remember any recent procedures or tubes in my gallbladder or bile ducts, and I haven’t had gallbladder surgery that I’m aware of. I’ve mainly just been managed at home through hospice, and I can’t recall anything like ERCP or stents being mentioned.
